rows.note: For a homeless person or vagabond, this is the everyday all-purpose choice.

example.english: That tramp sleeps at the station all the time.
example.traditional: 嗰個流浪漢成日喺車站瞓覺。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 lau4 long6 hon3 sing4 jat6 hai2 ce1 zaam6 fan3 gaau3

rows.note: Use this colloquial derogatory term for a woman regarded as sexually promiscuous or disreputable.

example.english: That tramp is hitting on married men again; she’s unbelievable.
example.traditional: 嗰個臭雞又喺度勾引人老公，真係離譜。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 cau3 gai1 jau6 hai2 dou6 ngau1 jan5 jan4 lou5 gung1 zan1 hai6 lei4 pou2
